hero.description: Building immersive 3D experiences & scalable web applications. React, Next.js, Three.js, Babylon.js.

chapters.body: Started as a kid who broke every UI component trying to add one more animation. Now I break them on purpose — and fix them 40ms faster each time.
I obsess over the 16ms budget. WebGL shaders, scroll choreography, magnetic cursors — the things most developers call 'nice to have' are what I build first.
Currently crafting immersive digital experiences in Dubai. Open to ambitious projects where the bar is set by the work, not the brief.
